a: A `<tspan>` that sets only `stroke-width` (or cap, join, dash) under a stroked `<text>` loses the override
A `<tspan stroke="inherit">` gets a black stroke and a spurious warning
`text: 'embed'` declares the substituted face's family but the `<text>` keeps naming the requested one
`svgNodesToKitDrafts` drops a stroke's `align`, so an inner or outer stroke re-imports centered
Dropping a large SVG scales leaves' stroke widths but not a group's, which its children draw with
The golden round-trip helper compares polygon coords without their `origin`
`dominant-baseline` is read only as the `<text>`'s own attribute, not through the cascade
A marker's outline width ignores the unit on `stroke-width`
`baseline-shift` in an absolute or font-relative unit other than em is read as that many ems
b: A `<text>`-level `baseline-shift` is dropped from every `<tspan>` run, so a node-level `script` with runs loses its shift on round trip
`strokeDataFromSvg` drops the stroke's `align`, so an inner/outer-aligned stroke unpacks centered
The fit-clamp in `unpackSvgFiles` turns an inherited stroke (`'inherit'`) into a garbage object and never scales the container's own stroke
Keyword properties are validated case-insensitively but read case-sensitively, so `display="None"` or `stroke-linejoin: Round` override the declaration below them and then read as absent
A `<pattern>` holding one `<image>` is read as an `image` paint without checking the image's `preserveAspectRatio` or `transform`
`roundTrip` test helper claims a deep-equal round trip but normalizes away most fields, so their loss passes
The fit-clamp leaves a framed text leaf's `padding` at source size
A `<marker>`'s outline width is read with `parseFloat`, ignoring the units every other stroke width converts
